engine/overworld/peon_large_masters_v021.diff:
diff --git a/engine/overworld/peon_large_masters_v0213.asm b/engine/overworld/peon_large_masters_v0213.asm
index a32f75a0..e83fa5ec 100644
--- a/engine/overworld/peon_large_masters_v0213.asm
+++ b/engine/overworld/peon_large_masters_v0213.asm
@@ -4,6 +4,74 @@
 ; Other shared-hut instances retain their normal palettes.
 SECTION "Peon large class master palette scope v0213", ROMX
 
+; RefreshSprites can sort the three static families into a different order
+; after a menu or battle. Rebind only their cached native tile bases; the
+; streamed actors have per-object slots. Do not recreate objects or change
+; positions, movement, facing, quest flags or saved records.
+PeonResyncMasterTileBasesV0219::
+	push af
+	ldh a, [hCGB]
+	and a
+	jr z, .Return
+	ld a, [wMapTileset]
+	cp TILESET_PEON
+	jr nz, .Return
+	push bc
+	push de
+	push hl
+	ldh a, [hMapObjectIndex]
+	push af
+	ldh a, [hObjectStructIndex]
+	push af
+	ldh a, [rWBK]
+	push af
+	ld a, BANK(wObjectStructs)
+	ldh [rWBK], a
+	ld bc, wObjectStructs
+	ld e, 0
+.Object:
+	ld hl, OBJECT_SPRITE
+	add hl, bc
+	ld a, [hl]
+	cp SPRITE_PEON_SHAMAN_MASTER_LARGE
+	jr c, .Next
+	cp SPRITE_PEON_WARLOCK_MASTER_LARGE + 1
+	jr nc, .Next
+	push af
+	ld hl, OBJECT_MAP_OBJECT_INDEX
+	add hl, bc
+	ld a, [hl]
+	ldh [hMapObjectIndex], a
+	ld a, e
+	ldh [hObjectStructIndex], a
+	pop af
+	call GetSpriteVTile
+	jr c, .Next ; keep the existing slot if this family is not allocated
+	ld hl, OBJECT_SPRITE_TILE
+	add hl, bc
+	ld [hl], a
+.Next:
+	ld hl, OBJECT_LENGTH
+	add hl, bc
+	ld b, h
+	ld c, l
+	inc e
+	ld a, e
+	cp NUM_OBJECT_STRUCTS
+	jr nz, .Object
+	pop af
+	ldh [rWBK], a
+	pop af
+	ldh [hObjectStructIndex], a
+	pop af
+	ldh [hMapObjectIndex], a
+	pop hl
+	pop de
+	pop bc
+.Return:
+	pop af
+	ret
+
 ; Configure transient map actors before graphics allocation. Native object
 ; masks load after MAPCALLBACK_OBJECTS, so appear/disappear with event=-1
 ; would not survive initialization. No new event flags or save data are used.
@@ -81,5 +149,5 @@ PeonLoadMasterRoomPalettesV0213::
 	ld a, BANK(wOBPals1)
 	jp FarCopyWRAM
 
-INCLUDE "gfx/large_masters_v0213/palettes.asm"
-INCLUDE "gfx/large_masters_v0213/graphics.asm"
